verdict.rationale: Azure Cost Management documents budgets with alerts on actual or forecasted cost, and Cost Management APIs for filtering and analysing spend, so the budgets-and-alerts core is covered first-party. The pack has no documentation of spend anomaly detection; forecast-based budget alerts are a different capability and are not counted as anomaly detection. missing for 10: documented spend anomaly detection, evidence that budgets/alerts are configurable from day one on new accounts, independent or hands-on corroboration that alerts prevent surprise bills.

support.subject: As a founder, the bill cannot silently explode — budgets, alerts, and documented anomaly detection on spend, configurable from day one

citations.quote: You can configure alerts based on your actual cost or forecasted cost to ensure that your spending is within your organizational spending limit.
The Cost Management APIs provide the ability to explore cost and usage data via multidimensional analysis
